question: Should Twilio RCS become a bundled first-party channel beside SMS, or should this implementation ship through the external plugin/ClawHub path?
rationale: Both boundaries are technically feasible with existing plugin seams; choosing the permanent distribution, ownership, compatibility, and support burden requires maintainer intent rather than code-review judgment.

options.title: External plugin path
options.body: Keep core unchanged and adapt or publish the RCS implementation as an external plugin with its own lifecycle, documentation, and live proof.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept RCS as a bundled channel, then require dependency authorization, upgrade/coexistence validation, and approved-sender proof before merge.

recommendation.title: External plugin path
recommendation.body: Keep core unchanged and adapt or publish the RCS implementation as an external plugin with its own lifecycle, documentation, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent bundled SMS channel history makes this the strongest available owner for deciding whether its RCS sibling belongs at the same distribution tier.
